title: An NSGo package or plugin, one file per package named after its slug

mark.description: One or two letters for the card.

official.description: true for a package inside NSGo's own module, which gives package and doc; community packages are false and give import and docs.

surface.description: The kind of app it serves: Go apps, TSX apps, or both.

package.description: An official package's folder in NSGo's module, such as base/datatable; the site puts the module path (NSGO_MODULE in packages/catalog/src/nsgo.ts) before it.

doc.description: An official package's page in NSGo's docs, as a path with an optional #anchor such as lists#tables; the site puts the docs' address (DOCS_BASE) before it. Left out when pkg.go.dev documents the package.

import.description: A community plugin's Go package, as the app imports it, such as github.com/someone/kit.

npm.description: An npm package the plugin comes with. NSGo compiles TSX with no Node, so its own packages have none.

docs.description: A community plugin's docs or repository link.
